info.description: Administration API for managing Magec multi-agent voice assistant resources.
info.title: Magec Admin API

get.description: Returns an agent by its unique ID
Returns the MCP servers linked to a specific agent

put.description: Associates a global MCP server with an agent

delete.description: Removes the association between an MCP server and an agent

get.description: Returns a backend by its unique name

post.description: Creates a new scheduled task that sends a prompt to an agent

get.description: Returns a cron job by its unique name

put.description: Updates a cron job by name

delete.description: Deletes a cron job by name

get.description: Returns all configured access point devices

post.description: Creates a new device. A unique auth token is generated automatically.

get.description: Returns a device by its unique name

put.description: Updates a device by name. Token is preserved.

delete.description: Deletes a device by name, revoking its access token

post.description: Generates a new authentication token for a device, invalidating the previous one

get.description: Returns all configured MCP tool servers

post.description: Creates a new MCP tool server

get.description: Returns an MCP server by its unique name

put.description: Updates an MCP server by name

delete.description: Deletes an MCP server by name

get.description: Returns all configured memory providers (session and long-term)

post.description: Creates a new memory provider. Type must be registered and support the given category.

get.description: Returns registered provider types with supported categories and config field specifications for dynamic form rendering
Returns a memory provider by its unique name

put.description: Updates a memory provider by name

delete.description: Deletes a memory provider by name

get.description: Pings the memory provider with a 5-second timeout to verify connectivity
Returns counts for all resource types and agent summaries
